cryptokeyhole_issuer_holdings_snapshot.method: Each fund's XRP flow is the change in its issuer-reported holdings between US trading days. USD values use CryptoKeyhole's own XRP/USD close for the UTC day. Missing funds are not filled or estimated; a daily total is partial until all four daily-tracked issuers publish.
cryptokeyhole_issuer_holdings_snapshot.source_independence: CryptoKeyhole says it reads issuer files every five minutes and does not work around issuer sites that refuse automated access. It is a distinct collector, but underlying files are the same issuer records used by other trackers.
